training_sensors: all three; frozen Table 2 reference checkpoints
fusion_sensors: exclude calibration sensor on both calibration and test
temporal_settings: inherit frozen block/window/scheme; normalized raw-space sensor score
coverage_sensor_row: uncorrected sensor reading in raw interval
coverage_raw_sensor_row: unadjusted sensor reading in raw interval
aggregation: pool calendar rows within seed; average Toy partitions; seed mean/std
raw_scale_definition: half raw predictive quantile span at Phi(-1), Phi(1); fixed floor 1e-8; sensor variance = gain^2 * posterior_variance + learned_sensor_variance; posterior scale excludes sigma_y
adaptive_scale_selection: user chose posterior after sensor-only development comparison
